entities.summary: Tyler Motte is an American professional ice hockey player who is a forward. He most recently played on a professional try-out for the Charlotte Checkers of the American Hockey League (AHL). Motte was drafted 121st overall by the Chicago Blackhawks in the 2013 NHL entry draft, and spent 33 games with the team in 2017 before being traded to the Columbus Blue Jackets. He has also played for the Vancouver Canucks, New York Rangers, Ottawa Senators, Tampa Bay Lightning, and Detroit Red Wings.
